# Inframill source snapshot

`inframill/` is an unmodified archive of commit
`acb50af152b4412110639ffaf7de1779f97304aa` from the Inframill repository
(`github.com/sir-hassan/inframill`, upstream module path). Its LICENSE is preserved.
That revision was not fetchable from the remote during Kit implementation.
Kit imports only the public `pkg/driver` protocol. Runtime builds compile this
same source snapshot; neither build requires a sibling checkout.
